feeds.title: Hip Foodie Mom
feeds.description: A fresh, food blog for quick meals and healthy recipes with step-by-step photos, how-to videos, and musings shared from a mom's point of view. One of the best family Food Blog focusing on delicious, easy-to-make recipes for everyone! The blogger focuses on ASIAN, KOREAN, and just easy weeknight dinners. Make meals for your FAMILY that they will actually eat and love!

feeds.title: Kimchimari
feeds.description: Kimchimari is a Korean mom's blog on Korean food and culture filled with in-depth information about ingredients and healthy eating. Browse hundreds of easy Korean recipes with step-by-step photos and video tutorials. Learn to cook authentic Korean BBQ, side dishes, noodles and more then stick around for in-depth information on ingredients & Korean culture.

feeds.title: Beyond Kimchee
feeds.description: Holly started blogging as a keepsake of her personal recipes to inherit from her children. That's why she made her blog more tutorial. So, cook up some Korean food tonight. Beyond Kimchee is a food blog with hundreds of wholesome, authentic Korean and Asian recipes that can be easily made at home.

feeds.title: Maangchi
feeds.description: Maangchi Blog Covers Korean cooking, recipes, videos, cookbooks, and photos, by Maangchi, who shares her knowledge, advice, photos, tips & tricks. It features the author's life, Korean food, events, meetups, contests, interesting stories, and updates from her lovely readers!

feeds.title: K-Mama Sauce Blog
feeds.description: Seoul for Your Food. Manufacturer of authentic Korean hot sauce

feeds.title: Korean Bapsang
feeds.description: Hyosun started this blog as a way to teach her children how to cook the food they grew up with. Through this blog, she hope to share the secrets of classic Korean home cooking and some of my other home favorites.

feeds.title: Mom's Korean Recipes
feeds.description: Mom's Korean Recipes is a mom-and-daughter blog sharing authentic Korean recipes. Grace does all the cooking by taste (with a handful of this and that as Korean moms do), while Esther follows her around the kitchen to meticulously measure all the ingredients.

feeds.title: Love Korean Food
feeds.description: If you Love Korean Food and want to learn more about Korean ingredients and recipes, you're in the right place! I hope to inspire you to cook Korean dishes at home with easy-to-follow recipes. I'm MJ, a recipe developer and cooking instructor who has taught over 10,000 students about cooking international cuisines.
